subject: cargo/khronos_api@3.1.0

policy_findings.locator: Heading states last updated August 2015; opening applicability and reproduction paragraphs.
policy_findings.finding: Observed default terms limit copying/distribution, give express unmodified redistribution permission to specified Khronos members subject to conditions, and distinguish implementation use from redistribution rights. Current retrieval does not authenticate exact historical 2018 page bytes.

policy_findings.locator: Complete current header, conditional copyright grant paragraph.
policy_findings.finding: Observed current header permits conditional reproduction of an unmodified specification and excludes patent/trademark rights. It is not an unrestricted MIT grant, and its historical applicability to these XML inputs is unproven.

Current guidance distinguishes specification source/markup licences from published HTML/PDF artifact licences and says the specification copyright licence should not be used on markup/source. This later guidance cannot assign a licence to the 2018 XMLs.

immutable_source_findings: The exact two 2018 core specification HTML sources contain copyright statements; targeted searches found no explicit permissive grant. Permission hits in WebGL 1.0 concern CORS rather than copyright.

The exact extension template XML and registry HTML contain no matches for the searched copyright/permission/licence/reproduction/redistribution markers. This bounded source search is not a rendered-site rights audit.
decision: UNKNOWN historical source rights; no new gate admission and no blanket specification-to-source licence inference.
next_action: A source-specific historical grant or licence-holder clarification is needed for the eight XML inputs; the inspected generic pages do not close that requirement. Continue independent blockers while preserving this evidence.
